Problem Statement:
Write a Java program to read and print a 2D matrix of integers. 
Input Description:
The program should accept: 
An integer r representing the number of rows in the matrix. 
An integer c representing the number of columns in the matrix. 
r × c integers representing the elements of the matrix. 
Output Description:
The program should print the 2D matrix in the same format as the input,
with each row printed on a new line. 
Sample Input:
3 3
1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 9 
Sample Output:
1 2 3
4 5 6
7 8 9
